prompt.text:
Implement an in-memory grayscale tile atlas in `solution.rs` using only the standard library.

Expose:
- `pub struct Tile { pub width: usize, pub height: usize, pub pixels: Vec<u8> }`
- `pub struct Atlas { pub width: usize, pub height: usize, pub pixels: Vec<u8> }`
- `pub enum AtlasError { EmptyInput, ZeroColumns, InvalidPixels { index: usize }, DimensionMismatch { index: usize }, Overflow }`
- `pub fn build_atlas(tiles: &[Tile], columns: usize) -> Result<Atlas, AtlasError>`

Tiles are placed row-major into a grid with the requested number of columns. The final row may be partially occupied; unused cells must contain zero-valued pixels. Every tile must have the same dimensions as the first, and each pixel buffer must contain exactly `width * height` bytes. Validate arithmetic with checked operations and report `Overflow` rather than panicking. Empty tile dimensions are valid when their buffer is also empty. Empty input and zero columns have their dedicated errors, with zero columns checked before tile validation. Report the lowest invalid tile index. Do not mutate or retain aliases to the input. Do not include a main function.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
